card.name: Digits after the decimal point in numbers
card.fires_on: A digit just after a decimal point or in the first digits of a number, mostly the upper end of a confidence interval or a table value. It is typically a number like 1.5 or 1.48 in risk ratios or dose tables.

modes.label: Confidence interval upper bound
modes.description: Digit in the second number of a range such as 95% CI 1.32 to 1.50.
